html:
/* Template:TreeSkills/styles.css - the skills of a tree as a grid of chips (Module:Skilltree, function skills). The number of columns
   is flexible, so the grid also fits beside the floated skill tree window. No overflow is hidden, so the hover cards are not cut off. */
.aa-ts {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(215px, 1fr));
	gap: 8px;
	margin: 0.5em 0 1.2em;
}
.aa-ts-passives {
	max-width: 1030px;
	grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(215px, 1fr));
}
/* fixed columns: the combat skills in 2, the Abyssal skills in 3 (fewer on a narrow screen) */
.aa-ts-combat {
	grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 250px));
}
.aa-ts-abyssal {
	grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 250px));
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
	.aa-ts-combat {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	}
	.aa-ts-abyssal {
		grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
	}
}
/* one skill: icon and name in a small card that lights up under the pointer. Every card has the same width (250px at most, like the passives). The padding belongs to the link itself, so the skill card opens wherever on the chip the pointer is. */
.aa-ts-item {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	box-sizing: border-box;
	min-width: 0;
	padding: 0;
	border: 1px solid var(--border-color-base, #a2a9b1);
	border-radius: 6px;
	background: var(--color-surface-2, #f8f9fa);
	font-size: 1.02em;
	transition: border-color 0.12s, background-color 0.12s;
}
.aa-ts-item .aa-skilltip {
	flex: 1 1 auto;
	gap: 10px;
	min-width: 0;
	padding: 6px 10px;
}
.aa-ts-pts + .aa-skilltip {
	padding-left: 8px;
}
.aa-ts-item:hover {
	border-color: var(--color-progressive, #36c);
	background: var(--color-surface-3, #eaecf0);
}
/* the card also opens over the badge and the tag */
.aa-ts-item:hover .aa-skilltip-card {
	display: block;
}
/* the points a passive needs: a round badge on the left */
.aa-ts-pts {
	flex: none;
	box-sizing: border-box;
	margin-left: 8px;
	width: 1.9em;
	height: 1.9em;
	border: 1px solid var(--border-color-base, #a2a9b1);
	border-radius: 50%;
	color: var(--color-subtle, #54595d);
	font-size: 0.85em;
	font-weight: bold;
	line-height: 1.8em;
	text-align: center;
}
.aa-ts-tag {
	flex: none;
	margin: 0 10px 0 -2px;
	color: var(--color-subtle, #54595d);
	font-size: 0.68em;
	letter-spacing: 0.06em;
	text-transform: uppercase;
}
